faq: Will my site go down during the move?

Only briefly, if at all. We build and test the new home in parallel, then switch at a quiet hour. Premium aims for near-zero downtime by syncing data right up to the switch, and the old system remains ready as a fallback.
Can you migrate from shared hosting?
Yes, that is one of the most common moves. We copy files, databases and settings, fix anything the new server needs, and test before switching. We need access to the old host's control panel or FTP.
Email is handled separately from the website, so it does not need to move with it. We check that your mail records stay correct during the switch, so messages keep arriving.
Do you move Shopify or Wix stores?
No. Those platforms host themselves. This service moves apps and websites you host yourself. For moving stores between ecommerce platforms, see our store migration services.
